name: laravel-agent-bench
description: A benchmark that evaluates coding agents on real-world Laravel engineering: subtle defects that pass visible tests but violate production invariants.

scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm bench node --test test/
scripts.docker:validate: docker compose run --rm bench node bin/bench.mjs validate
scripts.docker:vendor: docker compose run --rm bench node bin/bench.mjs vendor:prepare
scripts.docker:gate: docker compose run --rm bench node bin/bench.mjs validate --dynamic
